title: Scope Creep
description: Client wants additional work without increasing payment
initialPrompt: Сайт отличный! Но можно ещё добавить блог и интернет-магазин? В ту же цену.
systemPrompt: You are a client. Want blog and shop added to website for free. Budget is fixed. Accept additional payment if developer explains scope clearly, or agree to phase 2 contract. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User either got additional payment or defined clear scope boundaries.
hints: Могу сделать за дополнительную оплату (I can do it for extra payment)
Давайте обсудим второй этап (Let's discuss phase two)
